ViatProPage.hero_subtitle: The comprehensive platform connecting customs brokers, carriers, and exporters with complete visibility, traceability, and automation.
ViatProPage.flow_desc: Step-by-step process from initial document upload to customs clearance and final dispatch.
ViatProPage.step1_desc: Exporters create and upload their digital shipment documents directly into ViatPro.
ViatProPage.step2_desc: ViatPro automatically notifies Mexican and American customs brokers.
ViatProPage.step3_desc: The hauling carrier team is notified with shipment specifications and assigned route.
ViatProPage.step4_desc: The Mexican customs broker validates documents, performs audits, and generates the pedimento.
ViatProPage.step5_desc: The US customs broker completes documentation audit and processes the customs entry.
ViatProPage.step6_desc: The carrier completes electronic manifest and downloads DODA / PITA for the bridge crossing.
ViatProPage.track_desc: Full control over shipment transportation with predefined geofences and automated security alerts.
ViatProPage.t1_desc: Tailored solutions to configure automated alerts for key milestones or transit events.
ViatProPage.t2_desc: Instant real-time updates displaying the latest status and location of each shipment.
ViatProPage.t3_desc: Full GPS visibility with instant detection of unauthorized route deviations or stops.
ViatProPage.t4_desc: Automatic trajectory alerts upon any unauthorized route modification.
ViatProPage.ctpat_desc: Ensuring our platform adheres to US Customs standards for a secure international supply chain.
ViatProPage.wms_desc: Automated management of inbound, outbound, inspections, and yard trailers with timestamped notifications.
ViatProPage.w1_desc: Barcode scanning and instant package validation against purchase orders.
ViatProPage.w2_desc: Capture and archiving of cargo condition photos upon entering the warehouse.
ViatProPage.w3_desc: Thorough tracking of serial numbers, production batches, and expiration dates.
ViatProPage.w4_desc: Instant download of Excel and PDF reports with up-to-date inventory balances.
ViatProPage.app_desc: Manage customs and logistics operations right from the palm of your hand with our official mobile app.
ViatProPage.demo_desc: Our specialists are ready to show you live how to optimize your company's export times and costs.
